Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the AI Evaluation Scenario Writer position. With a background in digital marketing, SEO, and content creation, I have developed a strong ability to write clear, accurate, and well-structured content for diverse audiences. My daily work involves using AI tools like Claude and ChatGPT for research, content generation, and audits, which has given me hands-on experience in crafting prompts and evaluating AI outputs.

In my freelance and junior digital marketer roles, I have created and edited content for websites, blogs, and e-commerce stores, ensuring accuracy and adherence to quality standards. I have also built and optimized sites with structured data and conducted technical audits, which require meticulous attention to detail and verification from authoritative sources. I am fluent in English and comfortable working independently with flexible hours.

I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to pioneering AI research and would welcome the chance to discuss how my skills align with your needs.

Best regards,

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my interest in the AI Evaluation Scenario Writer position. As a digital marketer with a technical background, I have spent the past years creating and editing content that must meet high standards of accuracy and relevance—skills that directly translate to developing evaluation scenarios for autonomous AI systems.

In my current freelance work, I design and build websites, write SEO content, and use AI tools daily for research and content generation. For example, I built and optimized mirook.com, implementing structured data and running iterative technical audits that required verifying information from authoritative sources. Similarly, at Episto, I handle on-page SEO and content for client websites, ensuring every piece of content is precise and well-formatted. My experience with prompt engineering and evaluating AI outputs has given me a keen eye for detail and the ability to document findings granularly.

I am fluent in English and comfortable working independently with flexible hours. While my domain expertise is not in sports analytics or patent research, I have a proven ability to quickly grasp new domains and verify information rigorously—as demonstrated by my work with diverse client sites, from e-commerce to professional associations. I am eager to apply my writing and analytical skills to create challenging, real-world evaluation tasks that test and improve AI capabilities.

I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my background can contribute to your team. Thank you for your consideration.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
